description:
Deep in the mountains, where few people venture, Nak-Bin lives alone with his shaman mother. Unlike Nak-Bin, who longs to venture out into the world, his mother always dissuades him. It is precisely because of the immense shamanic power Nak-Bin possesses. She only wishes for her son to live an ordinary life. Despite her efforts, one day, Nak-Bin's power erupts uncontrollably. Nak-Bin summons the gods one after another. His mother desperately fights the gods, but is ultimately overwhelmed by their overwhelming power. Just as a mighty ancient god is about to kill his mother, young Nak-Bin steps forward to block the god. 

The god, impressed by his purity and courage, withdraws while simultaneously delivering an ominous prophecy to Nak-Bin. He is the chosen shaman of the ‘Primordial God’, a being who might bring about the world's destruction.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
